about: Pinned inputs of the ProsperoAI build. `make deps` (tools/deps.py) fetches every missing item and leaves existing checkouts and files untouched. Paths are relative to this repository; ../ means next to it.

items.name: payload-sdk
items.about: PS5 Payload SDK v0.42 (toolchain, libSceNet/libSceAgc import stubs, prospero-clang)

items.name: llama-cpp
items.about: llama.cpp at the revision the Vulkan backend migration is developed against (ggml-vulkan)

items.name: vulkan-headers
items.about: Khronos Vulkan-Headers (newer than the host's packaged 1.3.239; ggml-vulkan needs VK_EXT_layer_settings)

items.name: ps5-vulkan-tools
items.about: Mihawk's PS5_Vulkan: the RADV build and link recipes

items.name: ps5-payload-sdk-fork
items.about: Mihawk's PS5 Payload SDK fork used to build RADV
